summary: The Battle of San Pietro is a documentary film directed by John Huston about the Battle of San Pietro Infine, a World War II engagement sixty miles from Naples. The note says it was shot by Jules Buck. It was released in the U.S. in 1945 but was shown to U.S. troops earlier.
one_line: A 1945 documentary directed by John Huston about the World War II Battle of San Pietro Infine near Naples.
key_facts: The Battle of San Pietro is a documentary film directed by John Huston.
The film is about the Battle of San Pietro Infine.
The Battle of San Pietro Infine took place sixty miles from Naples during World War II.
The Battle of San Pietro was shot by Jules Buck.
The Battle of San Pietro was released in the U.S. in 1945.
The Battle of San Pietro was shown to U.S. troops before its U.S. release.
